title: Digital and Creative
detail: AI, data and tools like Python are being built into existing jobs across every sector rather than creating a wave of brand-new tech jobs, so digital skills need weaving into every specialism, not bolted on afterwards.

title: Sustainability
detail: From carbon reporting to retrofit-ready trades, green skills are becoming a normal part of many jobs rather than a separate 'green economy' - employers most often ask for waste management, carbon reporting and energy efficiency knowledge.

title: Visitor Economy
detail: Hospitality, tourism and events support thousands of local jobs and offer accessible first steps into work, though the sector needs stronger supervisory training and clearer routes into higher-paid roles.
